title: How does the shipper surrender the full set of originals at origin for a telex release?
content:
## Scope of application

Under the Bills of Lading and Transport Documents product, a telex release requires the full set of originals still in circulation to be surrendered at the origin office. The surrender is made by the shipper printed on the document, who alone can hand in the originals, and it is recorded with the number of originals handed in.

## Who may surrender

- The surrender is taken from the documentation party holding the record only when that party is the shipper printed on the document, meaning that its registered company name matches the printed shipper name exactly, character for character.
- Otherwise, the telex release request waits for the shipper.

## Entry condition

A document that has not yet been issued has no originals in circulation, so the full set can be surrendered only after the document has been issued under the issuance rules and its originals put into circulation. As the source clause puts it:

The document has been issued under bol_ issuance and its originals put into circulation before the full set is surrendered.

The reference in that clause is to the product's issuance rules. Where this is unmet, the surrender is not taken.

## Business effect

One call records the surrender of the given originals of the given set at the origin office on the current day, lowers the originals still in circulation by that number and moves the document to the status surrendered. Nothing is charged by this action. The customer then sees the surrender in the documentation history and the document shown as surrendered.

## How it is invoked

surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055 belongs to the customer: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves, that is, by the printed shipper acting as documentation party.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| bl_id | Reference number of the transport document whose originals are surrendered, as returned by the transport document lookup for the bill of lading number the caller quotes | Id text |
| request_id | Reference number of the telex release request on file for the document that this surrender answers, as returned by the documentation service request lookup | Id text |
| bl_set_sequence | The set the surrendered originals belong to: 1 for the first set issued, 2 for a replacement or switch set | Whole number, no decimals |
| originals_count | How many original documents are surrendered in this call | Whole number of 1 or more, no decimals |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the surrender entry reference (an opaque text id beginning "bss_"), the transport document reference, the telex release request answered, the set number, the number of originals surrendered at the origin office and the originals still outstanding. The appearance of that sentence is the success signal; the document then shows the status surrendered.

## Points of judgement

- **Question:** The documentation party is a forwarder that is not the printed shipper. **Answer:** The surrender is not taken from it; the telex release request waits for the shipper.
- **Question:** The document is still only approved. **Answer:** It has no originals in circulation yet, so the full set cannot be surrendered.
